name: 4CzIPN
description: D–A TADF benchmark (ΔEST 0.083 eV, ΦISC ~70%). Vis→UV: p-terphenyl ηUC 2.8%, p-TIPS-BP 8%, bTIPS-Bz (UVB) 2%. Refs 58, 64, 66.

name: 4CzPN
description: 3,4,5,6-Tetrakis(carbazol-9-yl)phthalonitrile. Parent of the pyrene-tethered conjugates. Ref 57.

name: 4CzPN-1DBP
description: 4CzPN covalently linked to 2,7-di-tBu-pyrene: intramolecular TET gives ~80× brighter UC in polyurethane films. Ref 57.

name: 4CzPN-2DBP
description: Two pyrene arms on one carbazole (3,6-positions). Ref 57.

name: 4CzPN-8DBP
description: Eight pyrene arms (all carbazoles 3,6-substituted); 520 atoms. Self-quenching between pyrenes limits UC. Ref 57.

name: 4CzBN
description: 2,3,5,6-Tetra(carbazol-9-yl)benzonitrile. T1 2.71 eV, τTADF 62 µs. With 1,4-TIPS-Naph: ηUC 26.2%, a record for vis→UV. Ref 63.

name: 4CzTPN-Ph
description: 2,3,5,6-Tetrakis(3,6-diphenylcarbazol-9-yl)-1,4-dicyanobenzene. First TADF-sensitized TTA-UC (Baldo 2015): 532 nm → DPA in a solid bilayer, ηUC 0.28%. Ref 45.

name: BN-2Cz
description: MR-TADF, ε 2.4×10⁵ M⁻¹cm⁻¹ at 490 nm, ΦISC 75%. Green-to-UV with 1,4-TIPS-Naph: ηUC 7.5%, Ith 15.8 mW cm⁻². Ref 44.

name: BN-2Cz-tBu
description: All carbazoles 3,6-di-tBu. Absorbs at 504 nm (ε 2.95×10⁵); Ith 9.2 mW cm⁻² with 1,4-TIPS-Naph; drives photopolymerization. Ref 44.

name: BN-Se
description: Se-embedded N/B/N MR-TADF: ΦISC 88%, ΔEST 0.08 eV, kRISC 1.6×10⁶ s⁻¹. ηUC 21.4% with 1,4-TIPS-Naph; Ith 1.3 mW cm⁻². Ref 62.

name: BBCz-SB-Br
description: Br-substituted B/N MR-TADF, ΦISC ~100%, ΔEST 0.17 eV. All-solid-state vis→UV with DPN emitters, ηUC up to 16.2% in solution. Ref 68.

name: DABNA-1
description: The first multiple-resonance TADF emitter (Hatakeyama 2016). Ref 85.

name: DABNA-2
description: DABNA-1 with Ph and NPh2 para to boron: f = 0.415 vs 0.205 for DABNA-1. Ref 85.

name: MR-1
description: N-centred triketone MR-TADF core with three bis(3,5-di-tBu-phenyl)amino donors. 532 nm → DPA, ηUC 14.0%. Ref 50.

name: BTZ-DMAC
description: Red D–A–D TADF (benzothiadiazole acceptor, 9,9-dimethylacridan donors). 532 nm → DPA, ηUC 1.9%. Ref 46.

name: BTZ-DMAC-4Br
description: Tetrabrominated BTZ-DMAC: heavy-atom effect lifts ISC (singlet-O2 yield 70%); 520 nm → DPA, ηUC 24.6%. Ref 48.

name: DMACPDO
description: β-Diketone D–A–D TADF (ΔEST 0.11 eV, ΦISC 86%). 455 nm → DPA, ηUC 22.3%. Ref 51.

name: DCF-MPYM
description: Dichlorofluorescein with two pyranylidene-malononitrile arms: red TADF (ΔEST 0.028 eV). 635 nm → DPA 428 nm, ηUC 11.2%. Ref 47.

name: S1 (BF2 curcuminoid)
description: NIR TADF BF2 complex (Adachi), ΦISC only 10.2%; with TTBP ηUC 0.052%. Ref 53.

name: S2 (Br-BF2 curcuminoid)
description: Br raises ΦISC to 53.7%. 724 nm NIR → TTBP 485 nm (ηUC 4.9%; 13.5% in methyl oleate); used for in vivo optogenetics. Ref 56.

name: Hep (heptazine)
description: Heptazine TADF sensitizer, T1 2.96 eV, ΦISC 83%. UVA/visible → UVC (~295 nm) with TIPS-benzenes. Ref 69.
